name: workbuddy-bridge
description: Delegate bounded, persistent, approval-gated local tasks from Codex to WorkBuddy. Also provides a native workbuddy_worker custom subagent with one-shot Hook delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate bounded WorkBuddy workers with native subagent
interface.longDescription: A versioned, persistent, auditable, approval-gated, worktree-aware bridge from Codex to the WorkBuddy CLI, plus a native custom subagent (workbuddy_worker) with plaintext Hook delivery.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded plan or confirmed scoped edit to workbuddy_worker.
Use the native subagent path for one-shot WorkBuddy tasks.
Run a confirmed scoped edit through WorkBuddy and verify the evidence.
